question: What does a major sync of a TrueHD stream say of the stream that no decode depends on -- the channel modifiers and the types of `format_info`, and the bits of `flags` -- what do real streams carry in those fields, and is a stream that says its delay through the decoder buffer is constant held to it?
method: The high-level bitstream description gives the fields (section 4.2.2, Tables 2 to 12): a two-bit modifier for each of the two-, six- and eight-channel presentations, read by a table the channels of the presentation select; a one-bit type for the last two; and sixteen flags, of which bit 15 says "the FIFO delay is constant for the entire duration of the audio bit stream" and bits 10 to 0 are reserved. `info` says the modifiers as coded and as meant, and `verify` files two things at `info`: a delay that differs from that of the unit before under a major sync that says it is constant (`buffer.latency_not_constant`), and a bit of `flags` without a meaning (`sync.reserved_bits`, which named four other fields before). `tools/declared.py` added the fields up over the streams of the corpus and over the first minute of every TrueHD and MLP track of a library. No stream sets bit 15, so the rule was measured on copies of three fixtures with the bit set and the checksums recomputed, against a second reading of the timing fields that is not the decoder's (`tools/delay_oracle.py`, from the trace `verify --trace-fifo` writes), and the copies were put to three other decoders as black boxes: a stream in, samples out. The streams of the corpus and the library are media and are not in the repository; the copies are made from fixtures that are.

reading: No real stream says its delay is constant: none of 71916 major syncs of the corpus and none of 92101 of the library sets bit 15, and the only bits of `flags` any sets are 12, the Evolution frames, and in the FBB streams 14. So the rule has fired on copies alone, where it finds what a second reading of the timing fields counts. 8 streams of the corpus keep one delay throughout and none says so; in the library the first minute of 1 of 157 tracks has one delay. The modifiers are what the tables of the description make of them wherever they apply, and where the tables give them no meaning encoders write 00: all 43 eight-channel presentations of the corpus with a channel beyond five and one, and all 140 of the library. None of these fields moves a sample in this decoder, in FFmpeg or in the Dolby decoder.
